newsitem.title: SOUTH KOREA: Kisan shrs up on tech tie-up rumours.
newsitem.headline: Kisan shrs up on tech tie-up rumours.

text.p: Shares of Kisan Co Ltd rose to their daily limit by midday on Friday on rumours that the company had agreed with a German firm to introduce technology for manufacturing of waste-treatment machinery, brokers said.
A Kisan spokesman refused to comment on the talk.
Kisan shares rose 800 won or 7.8 percent to 11,000 by the midday break.
"Rumours circulated that Kisan's earnings will increase when the company starts manufacturing the waste-treatment machinery under the tie-up," said a Hyundai Securities broker.
